tonight.headline: Love and Jefferson both practised fully Thursday
body: Bad news first: Alvin Kamara was limited again Thursday with the back (Saints report from Paris, 22 Oct) and stays the fourth back. That is the only thing on this roster that got worse today.

The two worries from this morning are gone. Jordan Love was upgraded to full participation in a padded practice and told reporters he is not missing the Lions game (Packers.com report 22 Oct 15:17; Yahoo 22 Oct 17:45Z). Justin Jefferson was upgraded to full (Vikings.com report 22 Oct). Both Friday fallback cards are stood down. ESPN projects 130.8 to JuiceJam's 112.0 — 60%, down from 63% because JuiceJam set their lineup at 19:43Z. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Nothing to do today.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: JuiceJam's Josh Jacobs (practised in pads Thursday, LaFleur 'ramping him up', Yahoo 22 Oct) gets a full workload in his first game of the season and CeeDee Lamb goes big on Monday night — their ceiling is about 25 points above the 112.0.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Friday's reports carry the game designations. Any designation for Love or Jefferson on Friday, after two days of full Thursday practice, would be new news — the Friday 07:00 run rechecks both.

whatWentWrong.title: Three bye players on the bench left no Sunday fallback — this week practice bailed it out
whatWentWrong.lead: Allen, Tuten and Diggs are on bye; Love and Jefferson were both limited Wednesday with nobody playable behind them.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Tuesday's waiver run brought Diggs (bye) for McLaurin and Metcalf for Allgeier, leaving Kamara and Metcalf — both in the 07:30 Paris game — as the only playable bench. On Wednesday Love (back) and Jefferson (ankle) were both on their teams' reports.

case.label: How it resolved
case.body: Both were upgraded to full on Thursday (Packers.com, Vikings.com 22 Oct), so neither fallback card has to fire. The roster did not solve it; the injuries did.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love or Jefferson is designated on Friday's report after Thursday's full practice — then the gap matters again and the Friday run re-arms the cards.

whatWentWrong.sources: ESPN activity log · Packers.com 22 Oct · Vikings.com 22 Oct

whatWentWrong.title: Week 6 was won with 11.0 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Kamara's 14.9 sat behind Allgeier's 5.8 and Love's 20.2 behind Allen's 18.3 — both projection calls, neither an override.

case.label: The numbers
case.body: 122.6 to 82.94 over Bok-aneers; best possible lineup 133.6 (week-6 archive, recomputed this run).

case.label: The lesson
case.body: Both were projection calls that lost. The fix is not to override — it is to set the lineup every week, which is done for Week 7: the lineup as set is the projection lineup.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Week 7 lineup set by projection leaves more than 15 points on the bench (archive).
